# Controller compatibility components

NXGS Play starts these components as separate programs to expose supported
PlayStation controllers to older Windows games as an Xbox/XInput controller.

## DS4Windows

- Project: https://github.com/ds4windowsapp/DS4Windows
- Version: 3.5
- License: GNU General Public License version 3
- Unmodified release source and binaries:
  https://github.com/ds4windowsapp/DS4Windows/releases/tag/Official

The complete corresponding source is available at the project link above and
in the release source archive. The bundled executable is invoked as a separate
program and is not linked into NXGS Play.

## ViGEmBus

- Project: https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus
- Version: 1.22.0
- License: BSD 3-Clause
- Release:
  https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases/tag/v1.22.0

ViGEmBus 1.22.0 is the vendor-signed final release with its updater removed.
